This project is a Vite-based React SPA deployed to GitHub Pages (no backend server). It uses PeerJS for peer-to-peer WebRTC connections and PixiJS for a spinning wheel that implements the Dread RPG's tension mechanic. Please generate code that fits a serverless, client-only architecture and integrates with the existing PeerJS message-passing pattern for real-time communication between players and the GM. See `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root for full architecture and conventions.
